description: This script generates a Swift file defining a host environment security policy based on a JSON configuration. It reads a JSON policy file, processes its entries, and outputs a Swift source file with the policy data embedded as static constants. It also supports check-only mode for verifying if the generated output is up-to-date.

methods.name: renderSwiftStringArray
methods.description: Converts an array of strings into a formatted Swift array literal with each element quoted and indented.
